rationale: origin/main has not advanced since this branch's base commit fc50683: `git rev-list --count fc50683..origin/main` returns 0. There is nothing to rebase onto and no upstream change that could touch the PLAN's foundation, so the classification is about an empty change set rather than a benign one. Every file the PLAN edits (internal/agentplan, internal/workspace, internal/plugin, internal/cli, test/functional, and the docs the finalization cascade transitions) is at the same revision the design was written against.
